messages:
Ava Morgan: quick heads-up — BrightLeaf (cust BL-231) flagged a discrepancy on March invoice INV-2026-042. Our embed counts show ~1.7k rows missing after an AZ failover at 03:12 UTC. Customer asked for provisional credit + backfill. @Ravi @Sofia :eyes:
Ravi Patel: do we know if those were dropped by ingestion or collapsed by the rate limiter? ballpark embed count and $ impact?
Ava Morgan: preliminary: expected 18,942 vs recorded 17,210 = 1,732 missing. At $0.20 / 1k embeds that's ~$0.35 credit. Query I used:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as observed
FROM embeddings_store
WHERE customer_id = 'BL-231' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Joel Chen: infra notes — AZ failover + our ip-based rate limiter had a 15s dedupe window; retry merge caused duplicate suppression. We've adjusted limiter config but need to scan other customers in the same window. Ava please open infra-oncall ticket.
Sofia Li: for finance: GL account GL-4420, memo: "Customer credit - embed undercount - INV-2026-042 - BrightLeaf". Proposed adjustment text:
```
Adjustment: Credit $0.35 to BrightLeaf (BL-231) for 1,732 missing embeddings. Root cause: AZ failover + rate limiter dedupe. Ticket FIN-3892.
```
FinOps Bot: Created ticket FIN-3892: "BrightLeaf embed undercount during AZ failover" — assigned to Ava Morgan. https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/FIN-3892
Ravi Patel: provisional approve :white_check_mark: pending infra confirmation and cross-customer scan. Please run a cross-customer query for the same time window and post results.
Ava Morgan: I'll apply a provisional negative invoice line now and follow up with a backfill if replay finds the missing rows. @Sofia please do the GL entry and close FIN-3892 when done. I'll attach scan results here.
Sofia Li: done — posting ledger entry id when complete. Thanks for the clear breakdown.
Ava Morgan: keeping this thread for the audit trail.
